headline: Real Madrid Retain Vinicius; Rodri Reports Diverge
paragraphs: Real Madrid's Vinicius Junior situation looks resolved for now. BBC's gossip column reported Wednesday that Madrid had resumed contract talks with the forward; by Thursday, Sky Sports described him as having committed to a new deal, a characterization from Sky rather than a confirmed announcement. Sky also reports that Arsenal, who had been mentioned earlier in the window as one club exploring Vinicius, are now looking at other options for their forward line.

Manchester City's Rodri saga has developed an inconsistency. Through most of the window, BBC's gossip column and a Guardian analysis piece both framed Real Madrid as the club pursuing Rodri, including two BBC reports in late July describing Madrid as confident of a deal. Sky Sports reports Friday that City instead rejected an initial offer from Barcelona as too low. The feed doesn't clarify whether both clubs are involved or whether coverage has simply shifted; the two versions conflict rather than confirm each other.

Elsewhere, Bayern Munich closed their pre-season Asia tour with a 2-1 win over Aston Villa in Hong Kong, per Sky Sports. Liverpool's news is quieter: BBC's gossip column reports the club is not pursuing Djed Spence, and a separate Sky feature describes centre-back Jeremy Jacquet, a reported £60m signing, as sidelined by a pre-season injury but expected to be worth the wait. No fresh Liverpool rumour this week reaches the scale of the Real Madrid or Man City stories.
